image: Fire up in heaven: Great Having.
So the noble one stops evil, lifts good,
lines: He has no dealings that harm: that is not harm.
If there is hardship: no harm.
He has a great cart to carry it.
A duke presents it to the Son of Heaven.
The small person cannot do this.
He does not swell himself full.

notes.name_en: 大有 great having/possessing; literal 'Great Having', not Wilhelm's 'Possession in Great Measure'.
